main_text.p: Cum Aff. שֹׁאֲפֵי Absorbet me, anhelus persequitur ad deglutiendum me, Psal.56.2. שֹׁאֲפוּ רוח Haurient ventum, Jer.14.6. Partic. וְאֶל־מְקוֹמוֹ שׁוֹאֵף Ad locum suum anhelat, Eccles.1.5.

שָׁאַר Reliquum esse, Superesse: Praeter. עוֹד שָׁאַר Adhuc reliquus est minimus, I.Sam.6.1. Niph. נִשְׁאַר Reliquum, Residuum esse vel fieri, Relinqui: Superstitem manere, Remanere, Superesse: Frequenter construitur cum Praepositione ב, qua quandoque per E, Ex, explicanda est. Praeter. הוּא לְבַדּוֹ נִשְׁאַר Ipse solus est relictus, Genes.42.38. cum Kametz propter pausam. Anomalum cum Epenthesi א: וְנִשְׁאַרְתִּי אֲנִי Et reliquus fui ego, Ezechiel.9.8. pro נִשְׁאַרְתִּי. Kimchi in Comment. scribit esse compositum ex Praeterito Niphal & Futuro Kal, quasi dicere Propheta voluerit: Cum percutientibus illis videre vellem, מִי נִשְׁאַר quis reliquus maneret? animadverti כִּי אֲנִי אֲשֶׁר quod ego tantum reliquus essem. Non dissimile vide in שָׁחָה in Hithpahel. וְלֹא נִשְׁאֲרוּ בָם Neque relinquerentur in eis, id est, ex eis duo pariter, I.Sam.11.v.11. Hiph. הִשְׁאִיר Reliquit, Reliquum, Residuum, Superstitem fecit vel reliquit: Praeter. לוֹ הִשְׁאִיר Reliquerunt ei superstitem, Num.21.35. וְהִשְׁאִיר אַחֲרָיו בְּרָכָה Et relinquat post se benedictionem, Josh.2.14. Futurum, וְלֹא נַשְׁאִיר בָּהֶם אִישׁ Ut non reliquum faciamus ex eis quenquam, I.Sam.14.36.

שְׁאָר m. Reliquus, Reliquum, Residuum, Reliquiae: In constructione non mutatur: שְׁאַר עֵץ Et reliqua ligna, Jesa.10.19. וּשְׁאַר רוּחַ לוֹ Et residuum, Jesa.14.22. Et (nonne) residuus spiritus ipsi? Mal.2.15. Vide hic Rabbi Salomonem. Chald. עִם שְׁאָר חַכִּימֵי Cum reliquis sapientibus Babyloniae, Dan.2.18. וּשְׁאָרָא Et residuum, Dan.7.7.

page.notes: The Hebrew points (vowel signs and dagesh) are small and partly worn on this scan; the vocalisation given is my best reading and is not certain, especially in the verse quotations and the Chaldee forms. Several Hebrew words in the Latin-gloss lines, notably in the Kimchi passage and the Hiphil forms, are uncertain and should be checked against the original. The running head "שא" and the catchword "שאר" are read from the scan. Hebrew word "שׁוֹאֵף" and "הִשְׁאִיר" may carry small printing variants.
